sections.title: Managed ClamAV scans
sections.description: Configure the default engine here. Manage additional engines on Endpoints. Socket and shared scan paths must already be mounted.

sections.title: External REST scanner
sections.description: Separate external scanner for API Scan and API Reports. Its jobs and webhooks are independent.

sections.title: Database & persistence
sections.description: Use H2 for a single-instance quickstart, or an existing PostgreSQL, MySQL or MariaDB database. Selecting a different database does not migrate users or jobs.

sections.title: Scan policy & upload storage
sections.description: Paths refer to this container. Docker mounts and host permissions remain deployment responsibilities.

sections.title: Quarantine
sections.description: Moving original files requires write access to their parent directory. Keep quarantine outside watched roots.

sections.title: Watched folders
sections.description: Configure individual watched directories on the existing Watch Directories page.

sections.title: Local recovery administrator
sections.description: An enabled local administrator is always retained. Manage local accounts and passwords on Users.

sections.title: LDAP / Active Directory
sections.description: LDAP / Active Directory uses verified LDAPS or StartTLS. Test connection validates transport and manager bind without saving. Group filters, membership/name attributes, nesting, timeouts, referrals and role maps use the same runtime validation. Changes apply after restart; keep an enabled local recovery administrator.

sections.title: OpenID Connect / SSO
sections.description: OIDC / SSO requires HTTPS issuer discovery and a confidential client. State, nonce and explicit group-to-role mapping remain enforced. Review and restart to apply saved settings; local login remains available.

sections.title: API tokens, CLI & MCP
sections.description: Manage scoped tokens on API Tokens. CLI/MCP clients run separately and use this application's HTTPS address.

sections.title: Webhook notifications
sections.description: Managed scan completion notifications for generic HTTP(S) or Discord receivers. Delivery is best effort with no durable retry queue.

sections.title: Reverse proxy & session security
sections.description: Optional forwarded-header handling for trusted reverse proxies. Direct HTTP configuration works without a proxy; choose none to ignore forwarded headers in a direct-access deployment.

sections.title: Private CA trust
sections.description: Mount an existing Java truststore first. This page cannot create a host mount or disable certificate verification.

sections.title: Prometheus & Grafana
sections.description: Scraping requires its separate token. Import the supplied Grafana dashboard; its panels consume real daemon and job samples.

sections.title: Mounted daemon configuration
sections.description: Inspect mounted clamd.conf/freshclam.conf without writing files or reloading ClamD.

sections.title: Preferences & recovery
sections.description: Theme/language defaults apply to browsers without a saved preference. Recovery works independently of the application database.

fields.label: ClamAV host or Unix socket path
fields.hint: TCP hostname/IP, or an absolute Unix socket path already mounted in this container.

fields.label: Database connection URL
fields.hint: Choose a database type to compose the JDBC URL. Existing data is never copied automatically.

fields.label: Baseline a reviewed legacy database
fields.hint: Only for a backed-up, compatible legacy schema without Flyway history. Not an upgrade shortcut.

fields.label: Watch interval (seconds)
fields.hint: The watcher checks every 30 seconds; longer configured intervals throttle those checks.

fields.label: LDAP URL
fields.hint: Use ldaps:// or ldap:// with StartTLS. The JVM must trust the directory certificate and its hostname.

fields.label: Base DN
fields.hint: Directory naming context, for example dc=example,dc=internal.

fields.label: Bind / manager DN
fields.hint: Service-account DN used to search users and groups; its bind secret is retained when left blank.

fields.label: User search base
fields.hint: Search base relative to the Base DN, for example ou=people.

fields.label: User search filter
fields.hint: Must contain {0}, replaced by the escaped login name; for example (uid={0}).

fields.label: Group search base
fields.hint: Group search base relative to the Base DN, for example ou=groups.

fields.label: Group search filter
fields.hint: Optional. Blank uses the group member attribute. {0} is the full user DN and {1} is the login name; for example (member={0}) or (memberUid={1}).

fields.label: Group member attribute
fields.hint: Attribute holding group membership, commonly member or uniqueMember. Used when the group search filter is blank.

fields.label: Group name attribute
fields.hint: Attribute used for exact group-to-role mapping, commonly cn.

fields.label: Use StartTLS
fields.hint: Required for ldap:// URLs. Leave disabled for ldaps://, which negotiates TLS immediately.

fields.label: Pool LDAP connections
fields.hint: Optional LDAP connection pooling. Use with LDAPS; StartTLS connections are not pooled.

fields.label: Search nested groups
fields.hint: Resolve parent group membership. The configured depth bounds recursive searches.

fields.label: Maximum nested-group depth
fields.hint: Maximum recursion depth from 1 to 8; used only when nested groups are enabled.

fields.label: LDAP referrals
fields.hint: Choose whether directory referrals are ignored, followed or reported as errors.

fields.label: Connect timeout (ms)
fields.hint: Connection timeout in milliseconds, from 1000 to 30000.

fields.label: Read timeout (ms)
fields.hint: Read timeout in milliseconds, from 1000 to 30000.

fields.label: Viewer groups
fields.hint: Comma-separated exact group names. Only explicitly mapped groups receive roles; unmapped users are denied.

fields.label: Operator groups
fields.hint: Comma-separated exact group names. Only explicitly mapped groups receive roles; unmapped users are denied.

fields.label: Admin groups
fields.hint: Comma-separated exact group names. Only explicitly mapped groups receive roles; unmapped users are denied.

fields.label: Requested scopes
fields.hint: Separate scopes with commas or spaces. Include openid; request groups only when supported by the provider.

fields.label: Groups claim
fields.hint: Claim containing groups; dot-separated paths are supported, for example realm_access.roles.

fields.label: Logout mode
fields.hint: Local clears the application session. Provider also requests provider logout when supported.

fields.label: Viewer groups
fields.hint: Comma-separated exact group names. Only explicitly mapped groups receive roles; unmapped users are denied.

fields.label: Operator groups
fields.hint: Comma-separated exact group names. Only explicitly mapped groups receive roles; unmapped users are denied.

fields.label: Admin groups
fields.hint: Comma-separated exact group names. Only explicitly mapped groups receive roles; unmapped users are denied.

fields.label: Allow internal webhook receivers
fields.hint: Requires administrator verification and restart. Metadata, link-local and reserved destinations remain blocked.

fields.label: Application HTTPS base URL
fields.hint: Optional canonical HTTPS URL for OIDC callbacks and client instructions. Leave blank to follow the current application request. Include any context path.

fields.label: Scrape token
fields.hint: Use 32–4096 printable characters without spaces.

fields.label: Separate management listener port (optional)
fields.hint: Publishing this port remains a Docker/Kubernetes responsibility.
